outgoing.name: Brothers Grimm
outgoing.excerpt: The libretto was written by Adelheid Wette (Humperdinck's sister), based on the Grimms' Hansel and Gretel.

outgoing.name: Folk music
outgoing.excerpt: It is much admired for its folk music-inspired themes, one of the most famous being the prayer from act II.

outgoing.name: Irish people
outgoing.excerpt: The screen play was by celebrated Irish author Padraic Colum.
